modules.title: Introduction to Ilu II and Idioms
modules.html:
Advanced Igbo proverbs and idioms and their uses. This section covers introduction to ilu ii and idioms.

Key points

  • Kammala ilu a: 'Atụrụ mma n'atụ nwanne, ọ rụọ nwanne, _____.' — O rụọ onye ọzọ.
  • Kammala ilu a: 'Gidi gidi bụ _____.' — Ugwu eze.
  • Kammala ilu a: 'Onye kwe, _____.' — Chi ya ekwe.
  • Mezuo ilu a: 'Ebe onye bi ...' — ...ka ọ na-awachi..
  • Ilu: 'Gidi gidi bụ ___' — ugwu eze.

Worked examples

Q: Kammala ilu a: 'Atụrụ mma n'atụ nwanne, ọ rụọ nwanne, _____.'
A: O rụọ onye ọzọ — The proverb 'Atụrụ mma n'atụ nwanne, ọ rụọ nwanne, o rụọ onye ọzọ' warns that whatever harm you wish for your brother will eventually reach you/others.

Q: Kammala ilu a: 'Gidi gidi bụ _____.'
A: Ugwu eze — The proverb is 'Gidi gidi bụ ugwu eze', meaning unity/strenuous effort brings honor.

examples.q: Kammala ilu a: 'Atụrụ mma n'atụ nwanne, ọ rụọ nwanne, _____.'

quiz.q: Kammala ilu a: 'Atụrụ mma n'atụ nwanne, ọ rụọ nwanne, _____.'
quiz.solution: The proverb 'Atụrụ mma n'atụ nwanne, ọ rụọ nwanne, o rụọ onye ọzọ' warns that whatever harm you wish for your brother will eventually reach you/others.

quiz.q: Kammala ilu a: 'Gidi gidi bụ _____.'
quiz.solution: The proverb is 'Gidi gidi bụ ugwu eze', meaning unity/strenuous effort brings honor.

quiz.q: Kammala ilu a: 'Onye kwe, _____.'
quiz.solution: The proverb is 'Onye kwe, Chi ya ekwe', meaning if you believe, your personal god will support you.

quiz.q: Mezuo ilu a: 'Ebe onye bi ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: ...ka ọ na-awachi..

quiz.q: Ilu: 'Gidi gidi bụ ___'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: ugwu eze.

quiz.q: Ilu: 'Nwa nza riri nne, o chefuo ___'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: chi ya.

quiz.q: Onye na-akpụ ihe site n'ụrọ n'ala Igbo bụ _____.
quiz.solution: 'Onye na-akpụ ite' (Potter) works with clay (ụrọ) to create pots and other utensils.

quiz.q: Onye bụ onyeisi n'akụkọ ifo Igbo niile?
quiz.solution: 'Mbe' (Tortoise) is the protagonist and trickster in most Igbo folktales.

quiz.q: Asụsụ Igbo nwere ụdị mgbochiume wo a kpọrọ 'Uda-anụ' (Voiced consonants)?
quiz.solution: Voiced consonants (uda-anụ) involve the vibration of vocal cords, such as b, d, g, and v.

quiz.q: Olee asụsụ e ji dee akwụkwọ 'Omenụkọ'?
quiz.solution: Omenụkọ, by Pita Nwana, was the first novel written in the Igbo language.

quiz.q: Udaolu ole dị n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Igbo has three tones: High (Elu), Low (Ala), and Mid/Downstep (Nsu).

quiz.q: Olee ụdị akụkọ na-ezi ezigbo omume ma jiri anụmanụ kọwaa ya?
quiz.solution: Folktales (Akụkọ ifo) use personified animals to teach moral lessons.

quiz.q: Kedu onye bụ onyeisi n'ezinụlọ n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: The father (nna) is the traditional head of the household.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ uru 'Ịmụ ọrụ' (Apprenticeship)?
options: Ịmụta aka ọrụ na inwe onwe
quiz.solution: The apprenticeship system helps youth learn trades and become independent.

quiz.q: Nna nna ndị Igbo:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Eri.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Adjective'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nkọwa.

quiz.q: 'Good morning' bụ:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ụtụtụ ọma.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Food'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nri.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Udaume' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Vowel.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Udo' pụtara?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Peace.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Kpakpando'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Star.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Azụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Fish/Back.

quiz.q: Wanne ne daga cikin wadannan haruffan 'Masu lankwasa' (Hooked letters)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: ɗ, ɓ, ƙ, 'y.

quiz.q: Cika karin magana: 'Komai nisan jifa ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: ...kasa zai dawo..

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Dabba'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Animal.

quiz.q: Menene 'Gona'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Farm.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Good afternoon' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ndeewonụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Shoe' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Akpụkpọ ụkwụ.

quiz.q: Olee ka a na-asụ 'Come here' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Bịa ebe a.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Igba nkwụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Emume alụmdi na nwunye.

quiz.q: Kedu n'ime ndị a bụ 'Nnumana' (Onomatopoeia)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kpam.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Dog'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Nkita.
